# Softika

> Softika is a software development studio specializing in AI agent development, secure automation pipelines, and scalable SaaS products. Founded as Softika Software Development e.U., the company delivers production-grade engineering for teams building intelligent systems.

## Core Services

- **AI Agents & Automation**: Multi-agent orchestration, LLM tool-calling pipelines, RAG and knowledge systems, human-in-the-loop workflows.
- **Agent Security & Guardrails**: Prompt injection defense, tool permission boundaries, output sanitization, compliance and audit logging.
- **SaaS Product Engineering**: Multi-tenant architecture, payment and billing integration, analytics dashboards, zero-downtime deployments.
- **Platform & DevOps**: Kubernetes and containers, CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, monitoring and alerting.
